description: This file manages resource progress tracking, including functions for updating, retrieving, and rendering progress states for topics within a learning roadmap. It interacts with external APIs, local storage, and DOM elements to reflect user progress.

methods.name: isTopicDone
methods.description: Checks if a specific topic is marked as completed based on resource progress.

methods.name: getTopicStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current progress status ('done', 'learning', 'skipped', 'pending') of a specific topic.

methods.name: updateResourceProgress
methods.description: Updates the progress state of a resource topic via API and updates local state and cache.

methods.name: clearMigratedRoadmapProgress
methods.description: Clears stored progress for specific migrated roadmaps in local storage, with limits on clearance count.

methods.name: getResourceProgress
methods.description: Fetches user progress data for a resource, interacting with API and updating global state.

methods.name: topicSelectorAll
methods.description: Selects DOM elements related to a specific topic ID for progress rendering.

methods.name: renderTopicProgress
methods.description: Applies visual classes to DOM elements to reflect a topic's progress state.

methods.name: clearResourceProgress
methods.description: Removes progress-related classes from DOM elements to reset visual state.

methods.name: renderResourceProgress
methods.description: Fetches progress data and updates DOM elements to reflect current progress for a resource.

methods.name: refreshProgressCounters
methods.description: Recalculates and updates progress counters and percentages in the DOM based on current progress.
